lesson.text: Quick memory: lost? What do you do first? (Stay where you are.) Today: never going off with anyone, a fire drill, the metro and a compass.
Someone says "come with me, I'll help": stay where you are and say no. Ask a shop worker with a name badge, a parent with children or a police officer.
A fire drill: leave your things, line up, follow your teacher calmly to the meeting point, answer your name and stay with your class.
A metro map: each line has its own colour. You change trains where two lines meet. Tap your ticket on the gate's reader and wait behind the yellow line.
A compass: hold it flat and still; the red needle points north. Clockwise: north, east, south, west, with north-east and the others between.
Try it in the world: open the practice market, school, metro and park. Next: bearings and map grids, on the Big track.
